reviews.text:
My first time using the kennels.
Lovely staff, large and clean facility.
My dog came clean and in great form
Would highly recommend.
Good kennels, a little out of the way. Would have been hard to find without Google
We love this place, such an ease being able to send our two here without a worry as they are so well looked after!

I have used Best Buddies for a few years now for my two dogs (German Shepherd and Belgian Malinois). One is sensitive around other dogs and the other can be sensitive around people but they both get on really well here and I wouldn’t put them anywhere else. Highly recommend.
Always a great experience here. The staff are lovely and my very nervous rescue always wags his tail at everyone there. Highly recommend

if you love your dogs, look somewhere else. we left our 11 year old dog here, and she has come back completely traumatised.

before staying here, she was outgoing, happy, and calm. she always wagged her tail, got excited when she saw the lead, and was full of energy for her age. when we picked her up, she was a completely different dog. she wouldn’t even look at us when we showed her the lead. her tail which was always wagging, is now still tucked between her legs. she barely ate when she got home and is still refusing food. the day after, she has had five seizures, worse than any shes had before. her back legs arent right, shes wobbly, weak, and has very low energy. she even flinches when we try to pet her, which is very strange because she used to love attention and never reacted this way. whatever happened to her during her stay has left her physically and emotionally scarred. we trusted this kennel with her care, and now we are left with a dog who is terrified and unwell. never sending them to any kennel again. thanks a lot
Fantastic service . Betty is a fantastic lady very professional. I would highly recommend this kennel.
We use these kennels a lot. They're really well situated and the facilities are great.

We are so happy with best buddies ! Got a recommendation from a friend and it didn’t disappoint ! Staff are so lovely and welcoming ! Able to bring home comforts and the place is very clean and warm! Will be able to enjoy any future breaks away knowing our dog is well looked after !
